verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single marketing line on the multi-currency page claiming Xero can 'generate consolidated financial statements in multiple currencies' (xero-docs-17). Nothing shows how multiple legal entities are managed together or how consolidation actually works, such as eliminations or intercompany handling. The API material describes integrations scoped to a single organisation (xero-gh-2). Missing for 10: documented multi-entity/multi-organisation management, consolidation mechanics (intercompany eliminations, group reporting setup), detailed first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
